description: This file contains unit tests for the resolveSlackBoltInterop function, which resolves various forms of Slack Bolt module imports to extract specific exported classes. The tests verify correct resolution behavior for different import scenarios and error handling when resolution fails.

classes.name: FakeApp
classes.description: A stub class used to simulate the App export from the Slack Bolt module.

classes.name: FakeHTTPReceiver
classes.description: A stub class used to simulate the HTTPReceiver export from the Slack Bolt module.

methods.name: resolveSlackBoltInterop
methods.description: A function that resolves the Slack Bolt module import object to extract the App and HTTPReceiver classes regardless of import style.
